title: Medieval Minors
description: A modpack that transforms the game into a medieval fantasy style game. Highly inspired by soulsborne games.
body:
Just a modpack that turns the game into a medieval style game. Inpired mainly by soulsborne games. With Combat from Epic Fight, Epic Nights, Adventure from Biomes O' Plenty and much more.
